stem:
Ira rolls the same marble across a polished tile floor and then across a strip of sandpaper. On the sandpaper the marble travels a shorter distance before it stops.

Which statements are correct?

statements.text: Friction between the marble and each surface opposes the marble's motion.
Friction is greater on the sandpaper than on the polished tile because the sandpaper is rougher.
Friction pushes the marble forward on the sandpaper so it travels farther there.

teacher.key_rationale: Friction opposes motion and is greater on the rougher sandpaper, so the marble stops sooner there. Friction does not push the marble farther on sandpaper.
